svg.title: What a small model learns from each set
svg.desc: Mean score with 95% interval, clustered by work, over 167 held-out questions. c2m: contains 64.1%, exact 46.7%, log-likelihood -0.41 nats per character; Unsloth: contains 61.1%, exact 43.7%, log-likelihood -0.53 nats per character; NeMo Curator: contains 61.7%, exact 41.9%, log-likelihood -0.24 nats per character; Untuned student: contains 74.3%, exact 27.5%, log-likelihood -1.05 nats per character. Contains is the pre-registered primary score.
